title: Use lighting-only RGB stream for scene-off orbit renders
objective: Fix scene-off orbit RGB output by using an existing lighting-only camera sensor stream for scene-off render groups instead of final_tone_curve_hdr_, while preserving final_tone_curve_hdr_ for scene-on groups.
instructions: The previous Builder delegation for this stalled and was terminated. Keep this recovery narrowly scoped.

In examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py, make scene-off render groups choose DefaultSceneRoot.lighting_only_post_process_input_2_ for the rgb output stream. Keep scene-on render groups on DefaultSceneRoot.final_tone_curve_hdr_.

Use existing evidence from examples/render_image_hypersim/run.py and editor/create_asset_bp_camera_sensor.py: BP_CameraSensor already has lighting_only_post_process_input_2_ and lighting_only_diffuse_color_ components.
Handle the lighting-only buffer value range safely when writing rgb PNG/video. If data is float 0..1 or HDR-like float, convert/clamp predictably to uint8 without changing current scene-on behavior.
Record metadata per setting showing the rgb capture component long_name/profile used and whether scene-off lighting-only RGB was requested.
Do not broaden into show flag, world-light, or flashlight-shape work except where needed to wire the selected capture component.
If the lighting-only component cannot be used with current BP_CameraSensor, return blocked with exact component/path and required asset/plugin change.
Update focused unit tests for scene-on/scene-off capture component selection, rgb visualization conversion, and metadata. Run the relevant unittest target. No Git commit.
expected_outputs: Code/test changes or a precise blocked ResultPacket.
definition_of_done: Scene-off render groups use a lighting-only RGB capture stream in metadata and setup.
Scene-on render groups continue to use final_tone_curve_hdr_.
